title: LearnHub
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.build: passed: TypeScript and Vite production build

notes: Built only LearnHub within this project; no agents, deployments, pushes, or external messages.
All specified videos, imagery, and Space Grotesk weights 300–700 are bundled locally.
Poster frames captured from original supplied videos prevent blank offscreen video rendering.
Mobile onboarding font is 36px to preserve three lines; desktop is 42px. Intermediate phone layouts wrap to avoid overflow.
Calendar weekday labels match the prompt verbatim.
Frontend state only; no backend persistence. Original media yields approximately 68 MB static build.
Screenshots display original-video poster frames for deterministic capture; production videos autoplay and loop.
